Translation validation is an automated validation of translations (i.e. runs of a compiler), which is based on a translation validator (i.e. the translation validation algorithm), and uses a translation validation oracle (i.e. an oracle for the translation validation algorithm) and a translation validation oracle generator (i.e. generator of the oracle for the translation validator).
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have shown how to validate translations in a fully automatic way, and how to do this for a large class of languages.
we have developed an automatic translation validation system for the C programming language.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the validation of a compiler can be done automatically, and that the validation process can be integrated into the development of the compiler.
, while translation validation is not a replacement for compiler verification, it can be used to complement it.
the validation of translations can be done automatically, and that it is possible to design validation algorithms which are both sound and complete.
